is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-w) and Ace-1 G119S (page 3, 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 3A shows observed mutation frequencies at each filial generation for three water types, and the text discusses these frequencies (page 6, 7).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from a vegetable farm in Opeibea, Accra, Ghana (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental evolution study conducted by the authors (page 1, 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the collection site as a vegetable farm in Opeibea, Accra, Ghana (5º35′56N; 0º10′59’W) (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted between September and October 2021 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new experimental evolution approach using mosquitoes collected in 2021.

supplement.evidence: The main text and figures provide the necessary data on mutation frequencies and bioassay results.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the impact of larval habitat (field water, tap water, distilled water) on insecticide resistance and metabolic enzyme activity in Anopheles gambiae s.l. over 10 filial generations. It tracked kdr-w (L995F) and ace-1 (G119S) mutation frequencies and performed WHO bioassays.
